What we do

Thatch, done the way it lasts.

Thatch is our craft — but as full roofing specialists, we also handle general roof repairs and leaks. From a brand-new build to a drip before the rains, every job gets the same hands-on care.

New thatch roofs

Design-led new builds in water reed or Cape thatch — from full homes to garden lapas, framed and laid to spec.

The hands behind the work

A craft you can stand under for thirty years.

Thatch Artisans is built on more than 25 years on the tools. Master thatcher Jami learned the trade the long way — reed by reed, ridge by ridge — and has been trading as Thatch Artisans since 2013, still walking every roof personally.

We work in proper water reed and Cape thatch, ridge it tight, treat it against fire and weather, and clean up like we were never there. No shortcuts hidden under the coat, because you'll be living under it long after we've gone.

“If it carries my name, it carries my word.” — Jami, Master Thatcher

Good to know

Thatch, answered.

With quality water reed and proper maintenance, a thatch roof commonly lasts decades. The ridge wears faster than the coat and is renewed periodically. Pitch, materials, weather exposure and upkeep all play a part — we'll give you a realistic estimate for your specific roof.

Thatch can burn, but the real risks are usually preventable: faulty electrics, chimneys, lightning and nearby fires. We apply fire-retardant treatment and pay close attention to ridging and detailing to reduce risk and help with insurance requirements.

Most insurers will, provided the roof is properly built, treated and maintained. Fire treatment and lightning protection are often conditions of cover. We can supply documentation of the work done to support your policy.

It depends on size, roof pitch, access, material and finishes — so there's no honest one-size price. The fastest way to a real number is a free site visit, where we measure up and give you a fixed, itemised quote.

A light annual check is ideal — combing the coat, clearing debris, inspecting the ridge and topping up treatment as needed. Catching small issues early is what keeps a roof going for decades. We offer maintenance visits to handle this for you.

We work across Cape Town and the wider Western Cape. Not sure if you're in range? Send your town in the quote form and we'll let you know right away.
